gs.zh: 英屬南喬治亞及南三明治群島

kn.zh: 聖克里斯多福及尼維斯

ky.zh: 開曼群島(英國海外領地)

pm.zh: 法屬聖皮耶與秘克隆群島

sh.zh: 聖赫勒拿、阿森松和特里斯坦-達庫尼亞
sh.en: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年累計住院9萬9,275例、303例死亡;古巴病例為預期9.2倍
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has reported 99,275 cumulative hospitalized dengue cases and 303 deaths this year, and Cuba's cases are 9.2 times expected levels.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉登革熱今年住院8萬4,369例、死亡2,256例,9月死亡148例。
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh dengue: 84,369 hospitalised cases and 2,256 deaths this year as of 4 October; 148 deaths in September alone.

news.summaryZh: 美國今年987例西尼羅熱,洛杉磯郡135例含5例死亡,已超過去年全年。
news.summaryEn: The US has reported 987 West Nile cases this year; Los Angeles County's 135 cases, including 5 deaths, already exceed last year's total.

news.summaryZh: 胡志明市今年34,161例登革熱,第38週新增1,462例,高於去年同期。
news.summaryEn: Ho Chi Minh City has reported 34,161 dengue cases this year as of week 38, with 1,462 in week 38 alone, higher than the same period last year.

news.summaryZh: 廣東省今年4–8月屈公病736例,8月496例,逐月上升,但遠低於去年同期。
news.summaryEn: Guangdong, China reported 736 chikungunya cases from April to August this year, rising monthly but well below last year's levels.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年登革熱6萬1,972例、死亡184例,9月新增2萬6,126例。
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh reported 61,972 dengue cases and 184 deaths this year as of 20 September, with 26,126 new cases in September alone.

news.summaryZh: 德國9/17新增2例惡性瘧確定病例,1例死亡,均未前往流行地區。
news.summaryEn: Germany reported two confirmed falciparum malaria cases on 17 September, one fatal; neither patient had travelled to an endemic area.

news.summaryZh: 胡志明市今年累計31,032例登革熱,已連續5週單週新增逾1,000例。
news.summaryEn: Ho Chi Minh City has reported 31,032 dengue cases this year as of 6 September, with weekly cases above 1,000 for five straight weeks.

news.summaryZh: 印度2015–25年瘧疾病例與死亡均降約80%,高負擔地區由155個減至33個。
news.summaryEn: India's malaria cases and deaths both fell about 80% from 2015 to 2025, and high-burden districts dropped from 155 to 33.

news.summaryZh: 歐洲15國今年1,086例西尼羅熱本土病例、61例死亡,超過過去10年同期平均。
news.summaryEn: Fifteen European countries reported 1,086 locally acquired West Nile cases and 61 deaths as of 3 September, above the past decade's same-period average.

news.summaryZh: 南韓今年首例本土日本腦炎確定病例,為60多歲未接種疫苗女性,疫情多於9至10月。
news.summaryEn: South Korea reported its first local Japanese encephalitis case this year on 9 September, an unvaccinated woman in her 60s; cases usually peak in September–October.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉登革熱42,590例住院、117死,單日住院1,558例創今年新高。
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh reported 42,590 hospitalised dengue cases and 117 deaths as of early September, with 1,558 hospitalised in one day, a yearly high.

news.summaryZh: 菲律賓屈公病今年849例疑似、52例確定,較去年同期增36%,第八區超流行閾。
news.summaryEn: The Philippines reported 849 suspected and 52 confirmed chikungunya cases this year as of 22 August, 36% above the same period last year; Region VIII exceeds the epidemic threshold.

news.headlineZh: 菲律賓/馬來西亞/印度/歐洲-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 菲律賓宿霧省2,324例登革熱、17死;馬來西亞逾6.2萬例、60死,疫情上升。
news.summaryEn: Cebu, Philippines reported 2,324 dengue cases and 17 deaths; Malaysia has over 62,000 cases and 60 deaths, with rising outbreaks.

news.summaryZh: 巴西今年截至8/22疑似茲卡11,017例、確定537例,占美洲病例75%。
news.summaryEn: Brazil reported 11,017 suspected Zika cases and 537 confirmed as of 22 August, accounting for 75% of reported cases in the Americas.

news.headlineZh: 馬來西亞/孟加拉-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 馬來西亞登革熱今年58,079例、55死,孟加拉住院2萬8,090例、77死。
news.summaryEn: Malaysia reported 58,079 dengue cases and 55 deaths this year as of 22 August; Bangladesh reported 28,090 hospitalised cases and 77 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 法國今年截至8/17本土屈公病25例、3起疫情,最大在西部吉倫特省。
news.summaryEn: France has reported 25 locally acquired chikungunya cases this year as of 17 August in three outbreaks, the largest in Gironde.

news.summaryZh: 歐洲今年截至8/5西尼羅熱245例、12例死亡,低於過去10年同期平均。
news.summaryEn: Seven European countries reported 245 West Nile cases and 12 deaths as of 5 August, below the past decade's same-period average.

news.summaryZh: 尼泊爾今年截至8/11日本腦炎46例、9例死亡,印度阿薩姆州7月156例。
news.summaryEn: Nepal reported 46 Japanese encephalitis cases and 9 deaths as of 11 August; Assam state in India recorded 156 cases in July.

news.summaryZh: 馬來西亞今年55,855例登革熱、49死,已超過2025年全年55,399例。
news.summaryEn: Malaysia has recorded 55,855 dengue cases and 49 deaths this year as of 11 August, already above 2025's full-year total of 55,399.

news.summaryZh: 南韓8/13發布全國瘧疾警報,今年201例較去年同期減43.4%。
news.summaryEn: South Korea issued a nationwide malaria alert on 13 August after vivax parasite genes were found in mosquitoes; cases are 43.4% lower than the same period last year.

news.summaryZh: 希臘今年截至8/5西尼羅熱65例、6死;義大利84例、2死,與去年相當。
news.summaryEn: Greece reported 65 West Nile cases and 6 deaths as of 5 August; Italy reported 84 cases and 2 deaths, similar to last year.

news.summaryZh: 胡志明市登革熱較去年同期增23.9%,菲律賓三寶顏市1,241例、12死
news.summaryEn: Dengue in Ho Chi Minh City rose 23.9% over the same period last year, while Zamboanga City in the Philippines reported 1,241 cases and 12 deaths amid rising transmission.

news.summaryZh: 美國8/4報告3例茲卡病例皆曾赴斐濟,斐濟未通報病例,可能被低估。
news.summaryEn: The US reported 3 Zika cases on 4 August, all linked to travel to Fiji, where no cases have been reported and infections may be underestimated.

news.summaryZh: 哥斯大黎加今年屈公病82例(確定48例),2016–25年無確定病例。
news.summaryEn: Costa Rica has reported 82 chikungunya cases this year (48 confirmed); it reported no confirmed cases from 2016 to 2025.

news.headlineZh: 斯里蘭卡/泰國/菲律賓-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡今年登革熱84,724例、62死,7月約2.9萬例
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka reported 84,724 dengue cases and 62 deaths this year, about 29,000 in July alone, concentrated in Gampaha District.

news.summaryZh: 馬拉威今年截至6月瘧疾病例117萬例、555死,較去年同期減少72%
news.summaryEn: Malawi's malaria cases fell 72% through June compared with last year, to 1.17 million cases and 555 deaths, which authorities attribute to expanded prevention.

news.summaryZh: 巴西登革熱今年累計111萬1,023例、259死,低於去年同期約321萬例
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported 1,111,023 dengue cases and 259 deaths this year through week 28, below last year's roughly 3.21 million cases.

news.headlineZh: 中國/菲律賓/法屬圭亞那-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 法屬圭亞那今年屈公病確定1,157例、2死,當局已發布警報
news.summaryEn: French Guiana's chikungunya outbreak has reported 1,157 confirmed cases and 2 deaths this year, and authorities have issued an alert.

news.summaryZh: 安哥拉馬蘭哲省今年截至6月瘧疾52萬例、418死,5歲以下兒童死亡率最高
news.summaryEn: Malanje Province, Angola, has reported over 520,000 malaria cases and 418 deaths through June this year, with the highest death rate among children under 5.

news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞黃熱病今年累計202例、90死,致死率44%,多數未接種疫苗
news.summaryEn: Colombia has reported 202 yellow fever cases and 90 deaths this year as of 15 July, a 44% fatality ratio, mostly among unvaccinated people.

news.summaryZh: 泰國今年截至7/8登革熱13,143例、19死,病例數約去年一半但仍上升
news.summaryEn: Thailand has reported 13,143 dengue cases and 19 deaths this year as of 8 July; case numbers are about half of last year's, but the trend is rising.

news.summaryZh: 美國西尼羅熱今年至少81例,約79%為嚴重神經侵襲性疾病,分布18州
news.summaryEn: US West Nile fever has reached at least 81 cases in 18 states this year, with about 79% severe neuroinvasive disease, eight times the annual average since 2004.

news.summaryZh: 泰國今年截至第28週茲卡病毒感染76例,疫情呈下降趨勢
news.summaryEn: Thailand has reported 76 Zika cases this year through week 28, continuing a downward trend from over 700 in 2023.

news.summaryZh: 菲律賓薩馬省甘達拉鎮屈公病累計至少84例,當局發布紅色警戒
news.summaryEn: Gandara, Samar Province, Philippines, has reported at least 84 chikungunya cases since May, mostly in two neighbouring villages, and a red alert has been issued.

news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡登革熱逾6.7萬例、47死,巴西疑似逾41萬例
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka has recorded over 67,200 dengue cases and 47 deaths, while Brazil reports more than 410,000 suspected cases nationwide this year.

news.headlineZh: 印度/法屬馬約特島-瘧疾
news.summaryZh: 印度賈坎德州腦性瘧疾150例、4童死亡;法屬馬約特島244例已超去年全年
news.summaryEn: India's Jharkhand reported 150 cerebral malaria cases including 4 child deaths, while Mayotte's 244 confirmed cases already exceed last year's full-year total.

news.summaryZh: 美國西尼羅熱今年截至6/30累計48例,12州報告,38例重症神經侵襲
news.summaryEn: US West Nile fever reached 48 cases in 12 states by 30 June, 38 with severe neuroinvasive disease, the highest for that time in 10 years.

news.headlineZh: 委內瑞拉-麻疹等震災後傳染病
news.headlineEn: Venezuela – Communicable disease risks after earthquake
news.summaryZh: 委內瑞拉6/24大地震後,WHO警告麻疹、登革熱等傳染病風險上升
news.summaryEn: After a 24 June earthquake in Venezuela, WHO warned of rising risks for measles, dengue, yellow fever, malaria and other communicable diseases amid low vaccination coverage.

news.headlineZh: 斯里蘭卡/孟加拉-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡登革熱今年截至6/27累計52,068例,孟加拉累計5,800例
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka's dengue cases reached 52,068 by 27 June, with 5,267 suspected cases added in one week, while Bangladesh has reported 5,800 cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 全球黃熱病美洲6國79例,非洲3國16例,未接種族群風險較高
news.summaryEn: Six countries in the Americas reported 79 yellow fever cases and three African countries reported 16 this year, with unvaccinated people at higher risk.

news.headlineZh: 馬來西亞/孟加拉-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 馬來西亞今年截至6/13登革熱33,367例、23死,較去年同期升27%
news.summaryEn: Malaysia has reported 33,367 dengue cases and 23 deaths by 13 June, 27% above last year, while Bangladesh's June-to-date cases are twice May's total.

news.summaryZh: 美國亞利桑那州馬里科帕郡西尼羅熱今年本土25例、2死,高於去年同期10例
news.summaryEn: Maricopa County, Arizona, has reported 25 locally acquired West Nile fever cases and 2 deaths this year, up from 10 cases last year.

news.summaryZh: 越南登革熱今年1-5月逾5萬例,為去年同期2.5倍
news.summaryEn: Viet Nam reported over 50,000 dengue cases from January to May, about 2.5 times last year's same-period level, while Sri Lanka's cases reached 36,168 by 5 June.

news.summaryZh: 法屬圭亞那屈公病累計509例,疫情由西部沿海擴散,美國CDC升至第2級
news.summaryEn: French Guiana has reported 509 confirmed Chikungunya cases since late January, and the US CDC raised its travel alert to Level 2.

news.headlineZh: 法屬馬約特島/葉門-瘧疾
news.summaryZh: 葉門塔伊茲省今年逾2.2萬例瘧疾,馬約特島累計197例,疫情均呈上升
news.summaryEn: Yemen's Taiz Governorate has recorded over 22,000 malaria cases this year, while Mayotte reports 197 cases; both are rising.

news.summaryZh: 巴西今年累計850,783例登革熱、153死,米納斯吉拉斯州6萬1,229例
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported 850,783 dengue cases and 153 deaths this year, including 61,229 cases in Minas Gerais State as of 25 May.

news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞2024年至5/17累計192例黃熱病、85死,疫情已擴散至10省
news.summaryEn: Colombia has reported 192 yellow fever cases and 85 deaths since 2024 across 10 departments, with spread beyond Tolima.

news.summaryZh: 聖保羅州2025-2026監測期累計9例黃熱病確診、5死,確診者皆未接種疫苗
news.summaryEn: São Paulo State, Brazil, has reported nine confirmed yellow fever cases and five deaths since July 2025, all unvaccinated.

news.summaryZh: 胡志明市近1週414例登革熱,斯里蘭卡今年累計29,589例、15死
news.summaryEn: Ho Chi Minh City reported 414 dengue cases in the week to 17 May; Sri Lanka has 29,589 cases and 15 deaths this year.

news.summaryZh: 馬約特島近1週32例瘧疾為今年單週最高,17例疑為本土
news.summaryEn: Mayotte reported 32 malaria cases in the week to 3 May, the highest weekly figure this year; 17 are suspected to be local.

news.headlineZh: 模里西斯共和國-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 模里西斯截至3/30累計735例屈公病確診,美國CDC旅遊警示升至第2級
news.summaryEn: Mauritius has reported 735 confirmed Chikungunya cases as of 30 March, and the US CDC raised its travel alert to Level 2.

news.summaryZh: 胡志明市今年截至第19週逾1.6萬例登革熱,斯里蘭卡累計27,754例
news.summaryEn: Ho Chi Minh City has over 16,000 dengue cases this year through week 19, up over 70% from last year; Sri Lanka has 27,754 cases.

news.headlineZh: 印尼/法國/德國-茲卡病毒感染症
news.headlineEn: Indonesia / France / Germany – Zika virus infection
news.summaryZh: 印尼疫情升溫,法國2025下半年至今年3月累計11例境外移入茲卡確診
news.summaryEn: Zika transmission is rising in Indonesia; France has reported 11 imported cases, most with Bali travel, since the second half of 2025.

news.summaryZh: 印尼2025年瘧疾70.6萬例為近年最高,主要集中東部,尤以巴布亞省為主
news.summaryEn: Indonesia reported 706,000 malaria cases in 2025, the highest in recent years, concentrated in eastern regions such as Papua Province.

news.summaryZh: 法國去年監測期間62例西尼羅熱感染、5死,普羅旺斯大區最嚴重
news.summaryEn: France recorded 62 West Nile human infections in its 2025 surveillance season, five fatal, with Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur most affected.

news.summaryZh: 薩摩亞近1週159例登革熱,累計5,386例確診;東加累計56例確診
news.summaryEn: Samoa reported 159 dengue cases in the week to 26 April, with 5,386 confirmed cases since 2025; Tonga has 56 confirmed cases.

news.summaryZh: 法屬圭亞那累計108例屈公病確診,82%在西部沿海,30例住院
news.summaryEn: French Guiana has 108 confirmed Chikungunya cases, 82% on the western coast, with 30 hospitalised; the first local case since 2014 was reported in January.

news.headlineZh: 香港/法屬瓦利斯和富圖那-登革熱
news.headlineEn: Hong Kong SAR / Wallis and Futuna – Dengue
news.summaryZh: 香港今年首例本土登革熱,21歲男性無旅遊史;富圖納島1例本土確診
news.summaryEn: Hong Kong reports its first local dengue case this year, a 21-year-old man with no travel history; Futuna Island also confirmed a local case.

news.headlineZh: 阿根廷/巴西/玻利維亞-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 阿根廷今年截至4/11累計5,506例屈公病,其中831例確診,多在薩爾塔省
news.summaryEn: Argentina has reported 5,506 Chikungunya cases this year as of 11 April, 831 confirmed, mainly in Salta Province.

news.summaryZh: 玻利維亞聖克魯斯省發布黃熱病健康警報,科迪勒拉縣2例確診、1例死亡
news.summaryEn: Bolivia's Santa Cruz Department has issued a yellow fever health alert after two confirmed cases, one fatal, in Cordillera Province.

news.summaryZh: 越南今年累計3萬1,927例登革熱、4死,南部疫情升溫
news.summaryEn: Viet Nam has reported 31,927 dengue cases and four deaths this year, with rising outbreaks in the south during the rainy season.

news.headlineZh: 巴西/哥斯大黎加/瓜地馬拉/墨西哥-屈公病
news.headlineEn: Brazil / Costa Rica / Guatemala / Mexico – Chikungunya
news.summaryZh: 巴西今年逾3.8萬例屈公病、15例死亡,中美洲及墨西哥亦有病例
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported over 38,000 chikungunya cases and 15 deaths this year; Costa Rica, Guatemala and Mexico also report cases, and PAHO issued alerts.

news.summaryZh: 納米比亞今年約2.8萬例瘧疾,東北部贊比西區近1週新增1,719例
news.summaryEn: Namibia reported about 28,000 malaria cases in weeks 1–10 this year; Zambezi Region in the northeast logged 1,719 cases in the past week.

news.headlineZh: 法屬新喀里多尼-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 法屬新喀里多尼亞登革熱疫情擴大,截至3月25日累計432例
news.summaryEn: New Caledonia reported 432 dengue cases as of 25 March, its first major outbreak since 2019, with over 80 new cases in one week; DENV-1 predominates.

news.headlineEn: Anguilla (British Overseas Territory) – West Nile fever
news.summaryZh: 英國海外領地安吉拉報告1例本土西尼羅熱,25歲患者已住院
news.summaryEn: Anguilla, a British Overseas Territory, reported a locally acquired West Nile fever case in a 25-year-old with no recent travel, now hospitalised.

news.headlineZh: 法屬圭亞那/蘇利南-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 蘇利南今年逾1,357例屈公病檢驗陽性、1例死亡,法屬圭亞那確診65例
news.summaryEn: Suriname has more than 1,357 test-positive chikungunya cases and one death this year, while French Guiana has 65 confirmed cases as of 22 March.

news.summaryZh: 納米比亞今年1-5週累計11,327例瘧疾,73%為本土病例,21例死亡
news.summaryEn: Namibia reported 11,327 confirmed malaria cases in weeks 1–5 this year, 73% locally acquired, with 21 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 美洲今年第1-7週4國34例黃熱病確診、15例死亡,CFR 44%
news.summaryEn: The Americas reported 34 confirmed yellow fever cases and 15 deaths (CFR 44%) in weeks 1–7 across four countries; PAHO issued an alert.

news.summaryZh: 巴拿馬今年1-2月累計1,232例登革熱,4例死亡,149例住院
news.summaryEn: Panama reported 1,232 dengue cases in January–February this year, including 4 deaths, with 149 patients currently hospitalized.

news.summaryZh: 蘇丹北方州截至3/7逾600例登革熱、4例死亡,智利復活節島報告本土病例
news.summaryEn: Sudan's Northern State has reported over 600 dengue cases and 4 deaths as of 7 March, and Chile's Easter Island reported a local case.

news.headlineZh: 阿根廷/玻利維亞-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 阿根廷薩爾塔省今年截至第8週屈公病36例,已出現本土傳播
news.summaryEn: Argentina's Salta Province reported 36 chikungunya cases (29 confirmed) by week 8 this year, and local transmission has now been recorded.

news.summaryZh: 委內瑞拉2025年6月至今年1月14州36例黃熱病確診,已擴散至低風險地區
news.summaryEn: Venezuela reported 36 confirmed yellow fever cases in 14 states from June 2025 to January this year, spreading to areas previously considered low risk.

news.headlineZh: 聖露西亞/古巴/法屬圭亞那/蓋亞那/蘇利南-屈公病
news.headlineEn: Saint Lucia / Cuba / French Guiana / Guyana / Suriname – Chikungunya
news.summaryZh: 聖露西亞2021年來首例屈公病確診,患者住院4天已完全康復
news.summaryEn: Saint Lucia reported its first chikungunya case since 2021; the patient was hospitalised for four days and has fully recovered.

news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡今年1-2月累計13,416例登革熱、4例死亡,主要分布於西部省
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka reported 13,416 dengue cases and 4 deaths in January–February this year, mainly in the Western Province.

news.summaryZh: 玻利維亞今年1-7週屈公病5,518例,聖克魯斯省近週增約1,000例
news.summaryEn: Bolivia reported 5,518 chikungunya cases in weeks 1–7 this year, and Santa Cruz added about 1,000 cases in the past week.

news.summaryZh: 巴西今年累計逾11萬例登革熱(逾2萬例確診)、8例死亡
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported more than 110,000 dengue cases this year, over 20,000 confirmed, and 8 deaths.

news.headlineZh: 蘇利南/玻利維亞/古巴-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 玻利維亞今年1-5週屈公病1,534例,東部聖克魯斯省1,409例最多
news.summaryEn: Bolivia reported 1,534 chikungunya cases in weeks 1–5 this year, with 1,409 in eastern Santa Cruz, the most affected area.

news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡今年迄今9,480例登革熱,西部省病例最多,當局啟動全國防治
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka has reported 9,480 dengue cases so far this year, most in the Western Province, and authorities have launched nationwide control measures.

news.summaryZh: PAHO發布警報,美洲去年屈公病313,132例、170例死亡
news.summaryEn: PAHO issued an alert on 11 February after rising chikungunya outbreaks in the Americas, which reported 313,132 cases and 170 deaths last year.

news.summaryZh: 薩摩亞自去年累計16,842例登革熱、8例死亡,近期1名7個月嬰兒死亡
news.summaryEn: Samoa has recorded 16,842 dengue cases and 8 deaths since last year, and a 7-month-old infant recently died.

news.summaryZh: 南非姆普馬蘭加省1月瘧疾314例,較去年同期多69例,洪水致病媒蚊增
news.summaryEn: South Africa's Mpumalanga Province reported 314 malaria cases in January, 69 more than last year, as flooding boosted mosquito breeding.

news.headlineZh: 蘇利南/哥斯大黎加-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 蘇利南1月累計137例屈公病,哥斯大黎加今年第2例確診為51歲女性
news.summaryEn: Suriname recorded 137 chikungunya cases in January, and Costa Rica confirmed its second case this year, a 51-year-old woman.

news.summaryZh: 葉門2025年登革熱明顯上升,15省累計逾2.4萬例病例及67例死亡。
news.summaryEn: Dengue rose sharply in Yemen in 2025, with over 24,000 cases and 67 deaths across 15 governorates.

news.headlineZh: 法屬圭亞那/蘇利南-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 法屬圭亞那首見本土屈公病病例,蘇利南報告134例及1例死亡,疫情上升。
news.summaryEn: French Guiana reported its first local chikungunya case since 2014, while Suriname's outbreak rose to 134 cases and one death.

news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞黃熱病自2024年累計161例、73例死亡,今年1月已有10例死亡。
news.summaryEn: Colombia has recorded 161 yellow fever cases and 73 deaths since 2024, including 13 cases and 10 deaths in January 2026.

news.headlineZh: 哥斯大黎加/蘇利南/巴西-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 哥斯大黎加2017年後首見屈公病;巴西盧卡斯市2025年1,769例。
news.summaryEn: Costa Rica reported its first chikungunya case since 2017; Lucas do Rio Verde, Brazil, recorded 1,769 cases in 2025, up from 11 in 2024.

news.summaryZh: 胡志明市近1週登革熱1,430例;越南2025年184,903例、43例死亡。
news.summaryEn: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City, with 1,430 cases in one week; Viet Nam recorded 184,903 cases and 43 deaths in 2025.

news.summaryZh: 印度坦米爾那都邦屈公病再度上升;美國佛州邁阿密-戴德郡出現首例本土病例。
news.summaryEn: Chikungunya is rising again in India's Tamil Nadu state; Miami-Dade County, Florida, reported its first locally acquired case.

news.summaryZh: 古巴2025年屈公病累計51,217例,近2,000例確診,15省均有病例。
news.summaryEn: Cuba recorded 51,217 chikungunya cases in 2025, nearly 2,000 confirmed, with cases reported in all 15 provinces.

news.summaryZh: 柬埔寨2025年登革熱63,016例、79例死亡,較2024年同期增232%。
news.summaryEn: Cambodia reported 63,016 dengue cases and 79 deaths in 2025, a 232% increase over the same period in 2024.

news.summaryZh: 秘魯2025年登革熱累計39,028例、54例死亡;北部及亞馬遜地區近6週上升。
news.summaryEn: Peru recorded 39,028 dengue cases and 54 deaths in 2025; cases rose over six weeks in the north and Amazon regions.

news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡2026年迄今登革熱2,170例,平均每日240例;洪水後疫情上升。
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka has reported 2,170 dengue cases so far in 2026, averaging 240 per day, after flooding raised transmission.

news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞2025年黃熱病118例、49死;托利馬省自2024年累計121例。
news.summaryEn: Colombia recorded 118 yellow fever cases and 49 deaths in 2025; Tolima has 121 cases since 2024, mostly among unvaccinated people.

news.summaryZh: 全球2025年屈公病逾50萬例、186例死亡,美洲、東南亞與西太平洋病例最多。
news.summaryEn: Chikungunya reached 502,264 cases and 186 deaths globally in 2025, with the Americas, South-East Asia and the Western Pacific most affected.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉第50週登革熱新增2,648例、13例死亡,較前一週下降22.8%。
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh reported 2,648 new dengue cases and 13 deaths in week 50, down 22.8% from the previous week.

news.summaryZh: 美國2025年西尼羅熱累計2,039例;科羅拉多州285例、17死,居全國之首。
news.summaryEn: The US recorded 2,039 West Nile fever cases across 46 states; Colorado had 285 cases and the most deaths (17).

news.summaryZh: 尼泊爾今年日本腦炎已報告35例死亡,6月以來新增175例,藍毗省最多。
news.summaryEn: Nepal has reported 35 Japanese encephalitis deaths this year and 175 new cases since June, most in Lumbini province.

news.summaryZh: 古巴2025年1至11月屈公病累計38,342例、21例相關死亡,14省受影響。
news.summaryEn: Cuba reported 38,342 chikungunya cases and 21 associated deaths from January to November 2025, affecting 14 provinces.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉登革熱集中於達卡與吉大港,美國CDC近期將旅遊警示提升至第2級。
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh's dengue is concentrated in Dhaka and Chattogram; the US CDC has recently raised its travel alert to Level 2.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉第48週登革熱新增4,128例、13死;菲律賓奎松市今年10,740例。
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh reported 4,128 new dengue cases in week 48; Quezon City, Philippines, has recorded 10,740 cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 印度10月登革熱增21%至22,659例;佛州今年本土登革熱累計60例。
news.summaryEn: India's dengue rose 21% to 22,659 cases in October; Florida has recorded 60 locally acquired dengue cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 香港新增1例本土屈公病,67歲女性居葵青區;今年累計78例,其中10例為本土。
news.summaryEn: Hong Kong reported a new locally acquired chikungunya case in a 67-year-old woman; 78 cases this year, 10 locally acquired.

news.summaryZh: 奈及利亞今年1-9月瘧疾逾2,446萬例,雨季後疫情持續上升
news.summaryEn: Nigeria's malaria cases are rising: over 24.46 million confirmed from January to September, with the rainy season driving further increases.

news.headlineZh: 越南/孟加拉/茅利塔尼亞/蘇丹-登革熱
news.headlineEn: Viet Nam / Bangladesh / Mauritania / Sudan – Dengue
news.summaryZh: 越南今年累計156,828例登革熱病例,死亡32例,孟加拉累計9萬餘例
news.summaryEn: Viet Nam has recorded 156,828 dengue cases and 32 deaths this year, with Bangladesh above 90,000 cases and Sudan having the most in Africa.

news.summaryZh: 全球屈公病今年累計458,840例、146例死亡,巴西病例最多
news.summaryEn: Global chikungunya cases reached 458,840 with 146 deaths this year, with Brazil reporting the most cases and the Americas leading.

news.summaryZh: 菲律賓登革熱減少8%至14,038例,阿富汗疑似病例上升
news.summaryEn: The Philippines' dengue cases fell 8% to 14,038 over 12–25 October, while Afghanistan's suspected cases rose, with 4,384 reported this year.

news.headlineZh: 孟加拉/墨西哥/美國-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 墨西哥今年確診14,652例登革熱,孟加拉累計逾8萬例
news.summaryEn: Mexico has 14,652 confirmed dengue cases this year and Bangladesh has over 80,000, while Florida reported three new local cases.

news.summaryZh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增107例,較前週下降,皆為輕症;香港累計59例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong's chikungunya outbreak continues to decline, with 107 mild cases in the past week; Hong Kong has reported 59 cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 尼泊爾今年164例確診日本腦炎、31例死亡,死亡為近10年最多
news.summaryEn: Nepal has recorded 164 confirmed Japanese encephalitis cases and 31 deaths this year, the most deaths in 10 years.

news.summaryZh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增259例、較前週868例大降,香港累計54例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong's chikungunya cases fell to 259 in the past week from 868 the week before, while Hong Kong has reported 54 cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 巴西聖卡塔琳娜州今年累計25,371例疑病例、20例死亡,DENV-3上升
news.summaryEn: Brazil's Santa Catarina state has 25,371 suspected dengue cases and 20 deaths this year, with DENV-3 cases rising sharply.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年累計逾6.5萬例登革熱、200餘例死亡,奎松市8,729例
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has recorded about 65,000 dengue cases and over 200 deaths this year, while Quezon City, Philippines, reports 8,729 cases.

news.summaryZh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增868例,江門終止三級應變;巴西庫亞巴10,978例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 868 chikungunya cases in the past week, with Jiangmen ending its Level III response, while Cuiabá, Brazil, has 10,978 confirmed cases.

news.headlineEn: Europe / United States – West Nile fever
news.summaryZh: 歐洲今年14國逾1,000例西尼羅熱本土病例,63例死亡,義大利714例
news.summaryEn: ECDC reports over 1,000 locally acquired West Nile cases in 14 European countries this year, with 63 deaths, mostly in Italy (714).

news.summaryZh: 香港今年截至10/22累計42例屈公病確診,均為移入,1名77歲男性死亡
news.summaryEn: Hong Kong has reported 42 confirmed chikungunya cases this year as of 22 October, all imported, including one death in a 77-year-old man.

news.summaryZh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增2,086例,較前週2,257例下降,無重症死亡
news.summaryEn: Guangdong's chikungunya outbreak continues, with 2,086 new cases in the past week, down from 2,257, and no severe or fatal cases.

news.summaryZh: 尼泊爾今年日本腦炎133例、31例死亡,74%為40歲以上未接種農業工作者
news.summaryEn: Nepal has recorded 133 Japanese encephalitis cases and 31 deaths this year, with 74% among unvaccinated agricultural workers over 40.

news.summaryZh: 馬爾地夫今年截至7/31登革熱累計821例,低於2024年同期
news.summaryEn: Maldives has reported 821 dengue cases so far this year as of 31 July, below the same period in 2024.

news.summaryZh: 紐約市報告1例屈公病本土病例,為美國2015年以來首例,傳播風險極低
news.summaryEn: New York City reported one locally acquired chikungunya case, the first US local case since 2015, and assesses the local risk as very low.

news.summaryZh: 美國今年截至10/7西尼羅熱1,433例,42州報告,較去年為高
news.summaryEn: The US has reported 1,433 West Nile fever cases in 42 states as of 7 October this year, 67% classified as neuroinvasive, higher than last year.

news.summaryZh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增2,257例,江門1,255例最多;法國本土累計700例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 2,257 chikungunya cases in the past week, with 1,255 in Jiangmen, while France's local cumulative total reached 700.

news.summaryZh: 全球屈公病今年445,271例、155例死亡,廣東為中國有紀錄以來最大疫情
news.summaryEn: Chikungunya has reached 445,271 cases and 155 deaths globally this year, while Guangdong's outbreak is China's largest on record.

news.summaryZh: 廣東近1週新增3,153例屈公病,江門2,927例;古巴馬坦薩斯省確診
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 3,153 chikungunya cases in the past week, 2,927 in Jiangmen, while Cuba's Matanzas province reported confirmed cases.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年登革熱累計約4.2萬例及179例死亡,單日新增740例住院
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has recorded about 42,000 dengue cases and 179 deaths this year, with 740 new hospitalizations in one day.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東近1週新增逾2千例屈公病,逾9成在江門;法國今年484例本土病例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong, China reported over 2,000 chikungunya cases in one week, mostly in Jiangmen; France has 484 locally acquired cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東9/7-13新增201例屈公病,為前週1.13倍,佛山最多
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 201 chikungunya cases from 7–13 September, 1.13 times the previous week, with Foshan most affected.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東疫情趨緩,近1週201例;孟加拉累計732例疑病例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong, China reported 201 chikungunya cases in the past week, with the outbreak easing; Bangladesh has 732 suspected cases this year.

news.headlineZh: 義大利/希臘/塞爾維亞/法國/羅馬尼亞/匈牙利/西班牙/阿爾巴尼亞/保加利亞-西尼羅熱
news.headlineEn: Italy / Greece / Serbia / France / Romania / Hungary / Spain / Albania / Bulgaria – West Nile fever
news.summaryZh: 義大利今年582例西尼羅熱,39例死亡,歐洲多國出現本土病例
news.summaryEn: Italy has reported 582 West Nile fever cases and 39 deaths this year, with 260 neuroinvasive cases; several European countries report local transmission.

news.headlineZh: 中國/法國/義大利-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 中國廣東近1週新增178例屈公病,佛山85例最多;法國今年301例本土病例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 178 chikungunya cases in the week to 6 September, with Foshan most affected; France has 301 local cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 尼泊爾迄今累計113例日本腦炎,23例死亡,多數為40歲以上未接種者
news.summaryEn: Nepal has reported 113 Japanese encephalitis cases and 23 deaths across 36 areas; most cases are over 40 and unvaccinated.

news.summaryZh: 越南今年累計67,055例登革熱,8月新增21,640例
news.summaryEn: Viet Nam reported 21,640 new dengue cases in August and 67,055 this year; Bangladesh has 30,376 cases and 118 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東近1週新增225例屈公病,佛山119例最多;全球累計逾27萬例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 225 chikungunya cases in the week to 30 August, down from 336; globally, over 270,000 cases have been reported this year.

news.summaryZh: 諾魯今年累計379例登革熱,薩摩亞累計3,070例確診及6例死亡
news.summaryEn: Nauru has reported 379 dengue cases this year, 77% aged 18 or under; Samoa has 3,070 confirmed cases and six deaths.

news.headlineZh: 中國/法國/義大利-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 中國廣東近1週新增336例屈公病,佛山206例最多;法國今年156例本土病例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 336 chikungunya cases in the week to 23 August, with Foshan most affected; France has 156 local cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 尼泊爾甘達基省近3週新增202例登革熱,博卡拉市432例最多
news.summaryEn: Nepal's Gandaki Province added 202 dengue cases in three weeks, with Pokhara City reporting 432; authorities expect further rises.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東今年逾9,000例屈公病,近1週830例,佛山644例最多
news.summaryEn: Guangdong has over 9,000 chikungunya cases this year, 830 in the week to 16 August, mostly in Foshan; France has 115 local cases.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東屈公病累計逾9,000例,浙江、福建等6省列為I類地區
news.summaryEn: Guangdong's chikungunya outbreak has exceeded 9,000 cases; authorities list six provinces, including Zhejiang and Fujian, as Category I risk areas.

news.summaryZh: 全球今年逾360萬例登革熱,2,000例死亡,美洲逾330萬例
news.summaryEn: Globally, over 3.6 million dengue cases and 2,000 deaths have been reported this year, with the Americas accounting for over 3.3 million.

news.headlineZh: 義大利/保加利亞/法國/希臘/匈牙利/羅馬尼亞-西尼羅熱
news.headlineEn: Italy / Bulgaria / France / Greece / Hungary / Romania – West Nile fever
news.summaryZh: 義大利今年173例西尼羅熱,11例死亡,72例有神經症狀
news.summaryEn: Italy has reported 173 West Nile fever cases and 11 deaths this year; 72 cases involved neurological symptoms.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東近1週新增1,387例屈公病,較前週減少,佛山1,212例最多
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 1,387 chikungunya cases in the week to 9 August, down from 2,892, with Foshan accounting for 1,212.

news.summaryZh: 中國廣東近1週新增2,892例屈公病,佛山2,770例最多,澳門報告2例本土
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 2,892 chikungunya cases in one week, 2,770 of them in Foshan; Macao has reported two local cases.

news.summaryZh: 截至7/30歐洲5國報告西尼羅熱確診,義大利拉蒂納省43例最多
news.summaryEn: As of 30 July, five European countries had reported West Nile fever cases; Italy's Latina Province had the most, with 43.

news.summaryZh: 薩摩亞近1週521例登革熱,累計2,277例確診及2例死亡,全校停課一週
news.summaryEn: Samoa reported 521 dengue cases in one week and 2,277 confirmed cases with two deaths since April; all schools will close for a week.

news.summaryZh: 澳門新增2例本土屈公病,香港首例境外移入為12歲男童
news.summaryEn: Macao reported two local chikungunya cases this year; Hong Kong's first imported case of the year is a 12-year-old boy who had visited Foshan.

news.summaryZh: 義大利西尼羅熱截至7月29日已致7例死亡,疫情延伸至中南部,預期8月達高峰
news.summaryEn: Italy has reported 7 West Nile fever deaths as of 29 July, spreading to central and southern regions; a peak is expected in August.

news.summaryZh: 廣東屈公病逾4,800例皆為輕症,近1週新增2,940例
news.summaryEn: Guangdong has reported over 4,800 Chikungunya cases, all mild, with 2,940 new cases in the past week, mostly in Foshan.

news.headlineZh: 辛巴威/波札那/史瓦帝尼/納米比亞-瘧疾
news.summaryZh: 辛巴威今年瘧疾126,229例較去年升296.8%,358例死亡
news.summaryEn: Zimbabwe has reported 126,229 malaria cases so far this year, up 296.8%, and 358 deaths, up 506.8%; neighbors are also rising.

news.summaryZh: 薩摩亞登革熱上升,近1週331例,累計1,276例、2例死亡
news.summaryEn: Dengue cases in Samoa are rising, with 331 reported in the latest week and 1,276 cumulative cases including 2 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 中國佛山屈公病累計逾4,000例,已備妥7,220張防蚊隔離病床
news.summaryEn: Foshan has reported over 4,000 Chikungunya cases since the first imported case on 8 July, and set up 7,220 mosquito-proof isolation beds.

news.summaryZh: 佛山截至7/23累計3,195例屈公病,WHO 7/22緊急呼籲各國行動
news.summaryEn: Foshan has reported 3,195 Chikungunya cases, all mild, as of 23 July; WHO urged countries to act urgently on 22 July.

news.summaryZh: 越南今年登革熱32,189例、5例死亡,低於去年同期,上升風險極高
news.summaryEn: Vietnam has reported 32,189 dengue cases and 5 deaths this year, below the same period last year, but the risk of a rise is very high.

news.summaryZh: 模里西斯今年屈公病累計1,540例、無死亡,7/4迄今新增100例
news.summaryEn: Mauritius has reported 1,540 Chikungunya cases this year with no deaths, including 100 cases since 4 July.

news.summaryZh: 印度阿薩姆邦今年日本腦炎32例住院、5例死亡,當局發布警報
news.summaryEn: Assam State, India, has hospitalized 32 Japanese encephalitis cases this year, 5 of whom died, and authorities issued an alert.

news.summaryZh: 法國本土屈公病30例、移入799例;佛山1,199例,澳門今年首例
news.summaryEn: France has 30 locally acquired and 799 imported Chikungunya cases; Foshan has 1,199 cases, and Macao reported its first case of the year.

news.summaryZh: 廣東佛山順德區截至7/15累計478例屈公病,皆為輕症
news.summaryEn: Shunde District in Foshan, Guangdong, reported 478 Chikungunya cases as of 15 July, all mild, after an outbreak began on 8 July.

news.summaryZh: 納米比亞瘧疾累計89,959例、146例死亡,韓國今年259例
news.summaryEn: Namibia has recorded 89,959 malaria cases and 146 deaths since late last year, while South Korea reports 259 cases this year.

news.summaryZh: 義大利北部皮亞琴察省1例疑似本土屈公病,為當地首例
news.summaryEn: Piacenza Province in Italy reported a suspected local Chikungunya case in a man over 65, the area's first; mosquito control has begun.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年登革熱逾14,000例、54例死亡;巴拿馬6,458例含10例死亡
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has recorded over 14,000 dengue cases and 54 deaths this year, while Panama reported 6,458 cases and 10 deaths by week 25.

news.headlineZh: 孟加拉-茲卡病毒感染症
news.summaryZh: 孟加拉吉大港2例42歲個案初檢疑為茲卡病毒感染,待確認
news.summaryEn: Chattogram, Bangladesh, reported two 42-year-old patients with preliminary tests suggesting Zika virus infection, pending confirmation.

news.summaryZh: 法國今年截至7/1本土屈公病14例,已擴散至大東部大區
news.summaryEn: France has reported 14 locally acquired Chikungunya cases as of 1 July, and the disease has spread to the Grand Est region.

news.summaryZh: 緬甸若開邦今年逾1,000例瘧疾、30例死亡,已超過去年全年
news.summaryEn: Rakhine State in Myanmar has recorded over 1,000 malaria cases and 30 deaths this year, exceeding last year's full-year totals; Ikongo, Madagascar, has nearly 200 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 宏都拉斯今年約7,500例登革熱(中美洲第2多),馬利1,918例
news.summaryEn: Honduras has about 7,500 dengue cases, second most in Central America, while Mali has 1,918 cases, second most in Africa.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年近1萬例登革熱,柬埔寨今年8,803例
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has nearly 10,000 dengue cases this year, with June cases above 5,500, and Cambodia has 8,803, above last year's same period.

news.summaryZh: 菲律賓今年登革熱累計123,291例,雨季將續升;越南今年22,974例
news.summaryEn: The Philippines has 123,291 dengue cases this year, with rising cases expected in the rainy season; Viet Nam has 22,974 cases and 5 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 全球今年屈公病約22萬例、80例死亡,巴西14萬1,436例居首
news.summaryEn: Globally, about 220,000 Chikungunya cases and 80 deaths have been reported this year, with Brazil accounting for 141,436 cases.

news.headlineZh: 新加坡/韓國-茲卡病毒感染症
news.headlineEn: Singapore / South Korea – Zika virus infection
news.summaryZh: 新加坡今年茲卡7例,6/18報告2例本土病例;韓國2例皆境外移入
news.summaryEn: Singapore has 7 Zika cases this year, including 2 local cases reported on 18 June; South Korea has 2 cases, both imported.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年登革熱累計5,739例、29例死亡,當局預估未來2個月續升
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has 5,739 cumulative dengue cases and 29 deaths this year, and authorities expect cases to keep rising for two months.

news.summaryZh: 法國普羅旺斯大區6/11報告今年首例本土屈公病,今年境外移入逾900例
news.summaryEn: France's Provence region reported its first local Chikungunya case of the year on 11 June, with over 900 imported cases so far this year.

news.headlineZh: 巴西/法屬馬約特島-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 馬約特島今年累計560例,住院增加;巴西1-5月逾15.8萬例
news.summaryEn: Mayotte reported 560 chikungunya cases this year with rising hospitalizations; Brazil recorded over 158,400 cases from January to May.

news.summaryZh: 印尼今年截至5月逾5.6萬例、250例死亡;巴西1-5月近271萬例
news.summaryEn: Indonesia reports over 56,000 dengue cases and 250 deaths through May this year; Brazil records nearly 2.71 million cases from January to May.

news.summaryZh: 美洲今年截至第20週累計221例黃熱病,89例死亡,為去年同期8倍
news.summaryEn: The Americas have reported 221 yellow fever cases and 89 deaths through week 20 this year, about eight times the same period last year; most cases were unvaccinated.

news.summaryZh: 法屬留尼旺島今年累計約5.2萬例屈公病、15例死亡
news.summaryEn: Réunion reported about 52,000 chikungunya cases and 15 deaths this year; cases peaked in week 13 and have since fallen below 2,000 a week.

news.summaryZh: 法國5月1-20日報告225例屈公病,今年累計逾950例,多來自留尼旺島
news.summaryEn: France reported 225 chikungunya cases from 1 to 20 May, about ten times last year's full total; more than 950 cases so far this year, mostly from Réunion.

news.summaryZh: 巴西今年累計約245萬例、逾1,000例死亡;巴拉圭累計16,033例
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported about 2.45 million dengue cases and over 1,000 deaths this year; Paraguay has 16,033 cases, with DENV-3 spreading in the community.

news.summaryZh: 巴拿馬報告2例瘧疾死亡,為2017年以來首見;2024年累計15,109例
news.summaryEn: Panama reported two malaria deaths, in a 10-year-old and a 15-year-old girl, the first since 2017; 15,109 cases were recorded in 2024.

news.headlineZh: 法屬馬約特島/法屬留尼旺島-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 馬約特島截至5/4累計116例屈公病,57例本土感染,無死亡
news.summaryEn: Mayotte has reported 116 chikungunya cases as of 4 May, 57 locally acquired, the first local transmission since 2005–06; no deaths reported.

news.headlineZh: 法屬留尼旺島/法國-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 留尼旺島今年累計逾4.75萬例屈公病、12例死亡;法國輸入766例
news.summaryEn: Réunion has reported over 47,500 chikungunya cases and 12 deaths this year; France has recorded 766 imported cases, nearly 97% of them from Réunion.

news.summaryZh: 秘魯今年截至4/20累計33例黃熱病、12例死亡,死者皆未接種疫苗
news.summaryEn: Peru has reported 33 yellow fever cases and 12 deaths as of 20 April this year; all deaths were in unvaccinated people, with 20 cases in Amazonas Region.

news.summaryZh: 薩摩亞宣布登革熱疫情,今年累計36例、1例死亡,主要在烏波盧島
news.summaryEn: Samoa has announced a dengue outbreak, with 36 cases and one death this year, mainly on Upolu Island; DENV-2 and DENV-1 are circulating.

news.summaryZh: 菲律賓截至4/21累計95,262例登革熱;東加累計625例、3例死亡
news.summaryEn: The Philippines reported 95,262 dengue cases this year as of 21 April, above the same period last year; Tonga has 625 cases and 3 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡今年迄今累計逾16,500例屈公病,西部省逾7,600例最多
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka has reported over 16,500 chikungunya cases so far this year, with more than 7,600 in the Western Province, mainly in Colombo District and Gampaha.

news.summaryZh: 納米比亞去年底至3/23累計逾3萬例瘧疾、60餘例死亡,超過2024年全年
news.summaryEn: Namibia recorded over 30,000 malaria cases and more than 60 deaths from late last year to 23 March, already above 2024's full-year total of 12,000 cases.

news.headlineZh: 法屬留尼旺島/法屬馬約特島-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 留尼旺島今年累計39,532例屈公病,近1週本土4,304例
news.summaryEn: Réunion has reported 39,532 chikungunya cases this year, with 4,304 locally acquired in the latest week; Mayotte has 55 cases, 17 of them local.

news.summaryZh: 巴西今年截至4/15累計近100萬例登革熱,634例死亡
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported nearly 1 million dengue cases and 634 deaths this year as of 15 April, with São Paulo State accounting for 578,937 cases.

news.summaryZh: 貝里斯西部卡優省4/15報告4例瘧疾,其中3例為本土病例
news.summaryEn: Cayo District in western Belize reported 4 malaria cases on 15 April, 3 locally acquired, the first local cases in six years.

news.summaryZh: 全球今年3月前累計約8萬例屈公病、46例死亡,巴西7.16萬例
news.summaryEn: Globally, about 80,000 chikungunya cases and 46 deaths were reported through March this year, most in the Americas, led by Brazil's 71,578.

news.summaryZh: 斐濟今年累計逾5,100例登革熱、3例死亡,已超過去年全年2,033例
news.summaryEn: Fiji has reported over 5,100 dengue cases and 3 deaths this year, already above last year's 2,033 total; Uruguay recorded 2 local cases.

news.headlineZh: 巴西/阿根廷/玻利維亞-茲卡病毒感染症
news.headlineEn: Brazil / Argentina / Bolivia – Zika virus disease
news.summaryZh: 美洲今年累計逾7,300例茲卡病毒感染,主要在巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞
news.summaryEn: The Americas have reported over 7,300 Zika cases this year, mainly in Brazil, Argentina and Bolivia; last year the region recorded over 40,000.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年累計2,052例登革熱、14例死亡;阿根廷確診逾2,800例
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has reported 2,052 dengue cases and 14 deaths this year; Argentina has more than 2,800 confirmed cases since week 31 of last year, mainly DEN-1 serotype.

news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞宣布衛生緊急狀態,今年57例黃熱病、22例死亡,致死率逾40%
news.summaryEn: Colombia declared a health emergency; as of 13 April this year, 57 confirmed yellow fever cases and 22 deaths were reported, an estimated fatality rate above 40%.

news.summaryZh: 斯里蘭卡今年登革熱逾1.1萬例、7例死亡;印尼累計逾1.07萬例、48例死亡
news.summaryEn: Sri Lanka reported over 11,400 dengue cases and 7 deaths this year; Indonesia recorded over 10,700 cases and 48 deaths as of 16 February.

news.headlineZh: 法屬留尼旺島/模里西斯-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 留尼旺島屈公病累計逾2.02萬例、2死亡;模里西斯2009年來首例本土病例
news.summaryEn: French Réunion has recorded over 20,200 chikungunya cases and 2 deaths; Mauritius reported its first local case since 2009.

news.summaryZh: 美洲2025年第12週黃熱病累計131例、53死亡,巴西病例最多
news.summaryEn: PAHO warns of rising yellow fever in the Americas: 131 cases and 53 deaths by week 12 of 2025, with Brazil reporting the most.

news.summaryZh: 巴西聖保羅州今年黃熱病32例、20死亡,已超過去年全年病例與死亡數
news.summaryEn: São Paulo State has recorded 32 yellow fever cases and 20 deaths this year, already exceeding last year's full-year totals.

news.headlineZh: 菲律賓/澳大利亞-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 菲律賓今年截至3/15登革熱逾7.6萬例,較去年同期升約78%
news.summaryEn: The Philippines has recorded over 76,000 dengue cases this year as of 15 March, about 78% above the same period last year.

news.summaryZh: 衣索比亞今年截至2月8日瘧疾逾90萬例、34死亡,第6週報告逾13萬例
news.summaryEn: Ethiopia has recorded over 900,000 malaria cases and 34 deaths this year as of 8 February, mainly in Oromia region.

news.headlineZh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
news.headlineEn: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained fatal illness
news.summaryZh: 剛果民主共和國不明致死疾病證實為瘧疾,累計2,957例、58死亡
news.summaryEn: DRC confirmed the unexplained deadly illness in Équateur Province is malaria: 2,957 cases and 58 deaths from 10 January to 16 March.

news.summaryZh: 秘魯今年黃熱病累計19例,遠高於2024年同期2例,皆有林區暴露史
news.summaryEn: Peru has recorded 19 yellow fever cases this year, far above 2 in the same period of 2024; all had exposure to forest areas.

news.summaryZh: 秘魯今年登革熱累計逾1.8萬例、28死亡,聖馬丁大區居多
news.summaryEn: Peru has recorded over 18,000 dengue cases and 28 deaths this year, 8 of the deaths in children; San Martín region has the most cases.

news.summaryZh: 澳洲新南威爾斯州今年第2例日本腦炎死亡,70多歲男性3月6日死亡
news.summaryEn: New South Wales reported its second Japanese encephalitis death this year, a man in his 70s, and the state's fourth since 2022.

news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞自2024年至今年2/21累計黃熱病40例、19死亡
news.summaryEn: Colombia has recorded 40 yellow fever cases and 19 deaths from the 2024 outbreak to 21 February, with six departments still affected.

news.summaryZh: 美洲今年登革熱累計逾102萬例,PAHO對DENV-3傳播發布警報
news.summaryEn: Americas dengue has exceeded 1.02 million cases this year; PAHO issued an alert on DENV-3 spread, while Paraguay reports about 1,000 cases weekly.

news.headlineZh: 菲律賓/阿根廷/東加-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 菲律賓西內羅省1-2月登革熱1,151例;阿根廷確診病例94.9%無旅遊史
news.summaryEn: Negros Occidental reported 1,151 dengue cases in January–February; in Argentina, 94.9% of confirmed cases had no travel history.

news.summaryZh: 全球今年截至2/25屈公病逾3萬例、14死亡,巴西31,484例居首
news.summaryEn: As of 25 February, 14 countries have reported over 30,000 chikungunya cases and 14 deaths this year; Brazil accounts for 31,484 cases.

news.headlineZh: 越南/斯里蘭卡/孟加拉-登革熱
news.headlineEn: Viet Nam / Sri Lanka / Bangladesh – Dengue
news.summaryZh: 胡志明市今年登革熱逾3,400例,病例遽增且高於去年同期
news.summaryEn: Ho Chi Minh City has over 3,400 dengue cases this year, rising sharply and above last year's level; Sri Lanka's outbreak is also rising.

news.summaryZh: 印尼屈公病上升,據去年12月資料7省571例,衛生部發布警報
news.summaryEn: Indonesia's chikungunya cases are rising: 571 cases in 7 provinces per December data; the health ministry has issued an alert.

news.summaryZh: 阿根廷今年茲卡病毒感染累計288例,去年564例;巴西去年逾4.2萬例
news.summaryEn: Argentina has recorded 288 Zika cases so far this year (564 last year); Brazil reported over 42,000 cases in 2024.

news.summaryZh: 法屬留尼旺島今年屈公病927例,2024年8月起本土病例累計1,069例
news.summaryEn: French Réunion has 927 chikungunya cases this year and 1,069 local cases since August 2024; the outbreak may spread island-wide.

news.summaryZh: PAHO 2/4發布警報:美洲黃熱病今年1月17例、7死亡
news.summaryEn: PAHO issued an alert on 4 February over rising yellow fever in the Americas: 17 cases and 7 deaths in January this year.

news.summaryZh: 衣索比亞今年瘧疾逾77萬例、31死亡,2024年逾1千萬例
news.summaryEn: Ethiopia has reported over 770,000 malaria cases and 31 deaths so far this year; over 10 million cases were reported in 2024.

news.summaryZh: 葡萄牙馬德拉群島2月初2例本土登革熱,當局評估疫情已受控制
news.summaryEn: Portugal's Madeira Islands reported 2 local dengue cases in early February; authorities say the outbreak is under control.

news.summaryZh: 菲律賓今年截至2/1登革熱28,234例,較去年同期升約40%
news.summaryEn: The Philippines has recorded 28,234 dengue cases this year as of 1 February, about 40% higher than last year; Quezon City's cases rose about 200%.

news.summaryZh: 今年截至1/22屈公病逾5,000例、2死亡;2024年62萬例、213死亡
news.summaryEn: As of 22 January, 2025 chikungunya had over 5,000 cases and 2 deaths globally; 2024 saw about 620,000 cases and 213 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 印尼南蘇門答臘省今年登革出血熱309例,孟加拉累計逾1,300例
news.summaryEn: South Sumatra has 309 dengue haemorrhagic fever cases this year, with 4 deaths in January; Bangladesh reports over 1,300 dengue cases.

news.headlineZh: 法屬留尼旺島/菲律賓-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 法屬留尼旺島2025年第4週新增屈公病31例,2024年8月起本土529例
news.summaryEn: French Réunion added 31 chikungunya cases in week 4 of 2025, with 529 local cases since August 2024; Davao City recorded 12 in 2024.

news.headlineZh: 菲律賓/哥倫比亞-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞烏伊拉省第2型登革熱爆發,宣布公衛緊急狀態,今年逾1.9萬例
news.summaryEn: Colombia's Huila Department declared a public health emergency over a serotype 2 dengue outbreak; Colombia has over 19,000 cases this year.

news.headlineZh: 菲律賓/巴西/伊朗-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 菲律賓西內羅省今年登革熱250例,較去年同期增297%
news.summaryEn: Negros Occidental, Philippines reported 250 dengue cases this year, up 297% on the same period in 2024; São Paulo, Brazil reported over 7,200 cases in week 1.

news.summaryZh: 印度2024年茲卡病毒感染151例,其中馬哈拉施特拉邦140例
news.summaryEn: India reported 151 Zika virus infections in 2024, 140 in Maharashtra, its highest since 2021; no microcephaly cases have been reported.

news.summaryZh: 巴西聖保羅州今年黃熱病累計7例、3死,已加強監測與接種
news.summaryEn: São Paulo State, Brazil, has reported 7 yellow fever cases and 3 deaths so far this year, with surveillance and vaccination stepped up.

news.summaryZh: 厄瓜多2024年登革熱逾6萬例、76死;秘魯今年累計逾7,800例
news.summaryEn: Ecuador reported over 60,000 dengue cases and 76 deaths in 2024; Peru has recorded over 7,800 cases and 6 deaths this year.

news.headlineZh: 澳洲/馬來西亞-日本腦炎
news.summaryZh: 澳洲昆士蘭州湯斯維爾1例及馬來西亞砂拉越州沐膠1例日本腦炎
news.summaryEn: Townsville, Queensland, and Mukah, Sarawak, each reported one Japanese encephalitis case; the Australian patient is hospitalised.

news.headlineZh: 法屬留尼旺島/巴西-屈公病
news.summaryZh: 留尼旺島屈公病累計192例,巴西今年截至1月17日523例
news.summaryEn: Réunion has recorded 192 chikungunya cases since 23 August 2024; Brazil reported 523 cases this year as of 17 January.

news.summaryZh: 全球去年截至11月登革熱逾1,400萬例、1萬死;澳洲湯斯維爾五年來首例本土
news.summaryEn: Global dengue reached over 14 million cases and 10,000 deaths last year to November; Townsville, Australia, reported its first local case in five years.

news.summaryZh: 多明尼加共和國去年截至第48週瘧疾984例,高於前一年同期265例
news.summaryEn: The Dominican Republic reported 984 malaria cases to week 48 of 2024, up from 265 in the same period of 2023, mostly in Azua.

news.summaryZh: 印度馬哈拉什特拉邦去年屈公病逾5,700例,為近6年最高
news.summaryEn: India's Maharashtra State reported over 5,700 chikungunya cases last year, the highest in nearly six years, mainly in Nagpur.

news.summaryZh: 巴西去年登革熱6,565,716例、5,954死;多明尼加共和國確診1,284例
news.summaryEn: Brazil reported 6,565,716 dengue cases and 5,954 deaths last year; the Dominican Republic recorded 1,284 confirmed cases, down 65.54%.

news.summaryZh: 非洲2024年黃熱病截至11月30日1,138例、7死,剛果共和國452例
news.summaryEn: Africa reported 1,138 yellow fever cases and 7 deaths as of 30 November 2024, with the Republic of the Congo accounting for 452.

news.headlineZh: 布吉納法索/維德角-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 非洲2024年登革熱累計176,481例、136死,布吉納法索與維德角最多
news.summaryEn: Africa has recorded 176,481 dengue cases and 136 deaths in 2024 to date, with Burkina Faso and Cape Verde reporting the most.

news.summaryZh: 維德角近1個月登革熱逾8,000例,2024年迄今累計44,410例、8死
news.summaryEn: Cape Verde reported over 8,000 dengue cases in the past month; 44,410 cases and 8 deaths were recorded in 2024 to date.

news.summaryZh: 孟加拉1月4日報告今年首例登革熱死亡,2024年累計10萬1,214例、575死
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh reported its first dengue death of 2025 on 4 January; 101,214 cases and 575 deaths were recorded in 2024.

news.summaryZh: 澳洲維多利亞州1例日本腦炎疑似病例,墨累河沿岸與新南威爾斯州蚊豬檢出病毒
news.summaryEn: Victoria, Australia, reported a suspected Japanese encephalitis case, possibly its first this season; the virus has been found in NSW mosquitoes and pigs.

news.summaryZh: 衣索比亞2024年瘧疾累計840萬例,為病例數最高的一年
news.summaryEn: Ethiopia reported 8.4 million malaria cases in 2024, averaging over 300,000 a week, its highest annual case count.

news.headlineZh: 孟加拉/哥斯大黎加-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 孟加拉2024年登革熱逾10萬例、561死;哥斯大黎加逾3萬例
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh reported over 100,000 dengue cases and 561 deaths in 2024 to 21 December; Costa Rica reported over 30,000 cases.

news.summaryZh: 印度德里2024年截至11月30日瘧疾766例,為近5年最高
news.summaryEn: Delhi, India, recorded 766 malaria cases as of 30 November 2024, the highest in five years.

news.summaryZh: 印度德里最近一週登革熱319例,今年累計5,701例,低於去年同期6,727例
news.summaryEn: Delhi, India, reported 319 dengue cases in the latest week; 5,701 cases so far in 2024, below 6,727 in the same period of 2023.

news.summaryZh: 全球2024年截至11月30日屈公病約48萬例、逾200死,巴西占40萬餘例
news.summaryEn: Globally, 23 countries reported about 480,000 chikungunya cases and over 200 deaths as of 30 November 2024, mostly in Brazil.

news.summaryZh: 歐洲2024年西尼羅熱本土1,436例、125死,義大利455例最多
news.summaryEn: Europe reported 1,436 locally acquired West Nile fever cases and 125 deaths as of 4 December 2024, with Italy recording the most at 455.

news.summaryZh: 美國佛州2024年本土登革熱74例;古巴13省快速蔓延,已見6例重症
news.summaryEn: Florida reported 74 local dengue cases in 2024; Cuba's outbreak is spreading rapidly across 13 provinces, with six severe cases found.

news.summaryZh: 南蘇丹西北部阿維爾兒童瘧疾6至9月每週約400例,高於去年同期
news.summaryEn: Child malaria cases in Aweil, north-western South Sudan, reached about 400 a week from June to September 2024, above the same period last year.

news.summaryZh: 巴西今年截至11月逾26萬例屈公病,截至8月已有159例死亡,超過去年全年。
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported over 260,000 chikungunya cases this year through November; 159 deaths through August already exceed last year's total of 122.

news.summaryZh: 巴西今年逾600萬例、5,086例死亡;越南胡志明市病例上升。
news.summaryEn: Brazil has reported over 6 million suspected dengue cases and 5,086 deaths this year, its highest case count since 1986; Ho Chi Minh City cases are rising.

news.summaryZh: 秘魯今年累計273,847例、252例死亡;尼泊爾病例自10月中旬起下降。
news.summaryEn: Peru has reported 273,847 dengue cases and 252 deaths this year, above the same period last year; Nepal's cases have declined since mid-October.

news.summaryZh: 印度今年累計1,548例日本腦炎,阿薩姆邦925例最多;德里逾10年首例。
news.summaryEn: India has reported 1,548 Japanese encephalitis cases this year, most in Assam (925); Delhi logged its first case in more than a decade.

news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞今年截至11月2日累計110,343例瘧疾,較去年同期增約8成。
news.summaryEn: Colombia has reported 110,343 malaria cases this year through 2 November, about 80% above the same period last year.

news.summaryZh: 歐洲今年累計1,375例本土西尼羅熱,113例死亡,高於去年同期。
news.summaryEn: Europe has recorded 1,375 locally acquired West Nile fever cases and 113 deaths this year through 6 November, above the same period last year.

news.summaryZh: 哥斯大黎加今年截至10月底累計27,791例登革熱,較去年同期增逾5成。
news.summaryEn: Costa Rica reported 27,791 dengue cases through late October this year, up more than 50% on the same period last year.

news.summaryZh: 印尼今年累計逾20.3萬例登革熱,1,210例死亡;尼泊爾較去年同期低。
news.summaryEn: Indonesia reported over 203,000 dengue cases and 1,210 deaths this year as of 19 October; Nepal's count is lower than the same period last year.

news.headlineEn: Central and South America – Yellow fever
news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞今年累計26例黃熱病,美洲截至第35週38例確診、19例死亡。
news.summaryEn: Colombia has reported 26 yellow fever cases this year through 7 November; across the Americas, 38 confirmed cases and 19 deaths by week 35.

news.summaryZh: 巴基斯坦信德省逾411例疑似屈公病、153例確診;印度馬爾達縣24例。
news.summaryEn: Pakistan's Sindh Province has over 411 suspected chikungunya cases this year, 153 confirmed; India's Malda District has reported 24 cases.

news.headlineZh: 孟加拉/巴基斯坦-登革熱
news.summaryZh: 孟加拉今年累計逾6.5萬例登革熱,326例死亡;巴基斯坦信德省1,724例。
news.summaryEn: Bangladesh has reported over 65,000 dengue cases and 326 deaths this year; Pakistan's Sindh Province has reported 1,724 cases, 1 death.

news.summaryZh: 尼泊爾今年累計80例日本腦炎,23例死亡,致死率逾28%,超過去年7例死亡。
news.summaryEn: Nepal has reported 80 Japanese encephalitis cases this year from 30 districts, with 23 deaths, a fatality rate above 28%, exceeding last year's 7 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 義大利維羅納11/7新增1例境外移入瘧疾,自1970年代起無本土病例。
news.summaryEn: Italy reported one imported malaria case in Verona on 7 November, linked to recent travel to Nigeria; Italy has had no local cases since the 1970s.

news.summaryZh: 葉門塔伊茲省今年累計4,338例瘧疾,多明尼加842例且高於去年同期。
news.summaryEn: Yemen's Taiz Governorate has reported 4,338 malaria cases this year with no deaths; the Dominican Republic has 842 cases, above last year's 213 for the same period.

news.headlineZh: 哥倫比亞/幾內亞-黃熱病
news.summaryZh: 哥倫比亞報告1例死亡;幾內亞新增2例黃熱病,非洲累計703例。
news.summaryEn: Colombia reported a yellow fever death on 29 October; Guinea reported two cases in Labé Region, and Africa has 703 cases and 6 deaths.

news.summaryZh: 廣東省第43週新增1,785例登革熱,累計約1萬例,今年無死亡。
news.summaryEn: Guangdong reported 1,785 dengue cases in week 43 and about 10,000 cumulatively since 9 September, with no deaths this year.

news.summaryZh: 義大利今年本土194例、境外456例;法國本土80例,高於2022年65例。
news.summaryEn: Italy reported 194 local and 456 imported dengue cases this year, France 80 local cases, above 2022's 65; Spain has 8 local cases so far.

news.summaryZh: 印度那浦爾市今年截至10/18逾1,000例屈公病,9月達高峰。
news.summaryEn: Nagpur, India, has reported over 1,000 chikungunya cases this year as of 18 October, peaking in September; rains may spur a rebound.

news.summaryZh: 希臘今年6/21起累計213例西尼羅熱,33例死亡,去年全年162例。
news.summaryEn: Greece has reported 213 West Nile fever cases since 21 June this year, including 33 deaths; last year's full-year total was 162 cases.

news.summaryZh: 印度德里今年截至10/5累計511例瘧疾,無死亡,高於近4年同期。
news.summaryEn: Delhi has reported 511 malaria cases this year as of 5 October, with no deaths, above the same period in each of the past four years.

news.summaryZh: 全球今年累計逾1,300萬例登革熱、8,500例死亡,巴西居美洲之首。
news.summaryEn: Globally more than 13 million dengue cases and 8,500 deaths have been reported this year; Brazil leads the Americas, with cases rising in Bangladesh and Nepal.
